notes.title: Soul Gather – Atmospheric Lighting Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Soul Gather – Atmospheric Lighting Update[/b][/p][p]💡 [b]What's New[/b][/p][p][b]Enemy Proximity Spotlight[/b]
Enemies now trigger dynamic flashing lights when nearby, intensifying tension during encounters and hinting at hidden dangers.[/p][p][b]Level-Wide Lighting Overhaul[/b]
All environments have been re-lit to enhance depth, mood, and clarity. Expect stronger contrasts, richer shadows, and a colder sense of dread lurking in every corner.[/p][p][b]Enhanced Normal Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Ghost Girl (Level 1):[/i] Subtle surface detailing has been added to her model. Her skin now catches light with unnerving realism, making her spectral presence feel more tangible. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540246/e7333de44fc400a8723d3024b6e2982120915c7a.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][i]Frostfangs:[/i] These icy terrors now feature upgraded textures and glowing red eyes, amplifying their menace in both well-lit and low-lit scenes.[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540246/7b294e13cb401e4c5939346a2bacdbe2313b9de3.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vampire Shader Overhaul – Welcome Visitor Level[/b]
The vampire now features refined shader treatments to enhance skin reflectivity and eye glow. This update heightens the horror through subtle lighting and a dramatic red spotlight.[/p][p][b]Ambient Sound Tuning[/b]
Background audio across several levels has been updated to reflect new lighting conditions and entity behavior, deepening player immersion.[/p][p][b]Collision Map Adjustments[/b]
New collision maps have been implemented to improve environmental balance and gameplay flow.[/p][p][b]Resolution Scaling Presets[/b]
Players can now choose from FidelityFX Super Resolution-style presets—Quality, Balanced, or Performance—to boost performance on lower-end hardware.[/p][p]Huge Frame Rate boosts[/p][p][b]Optional Supersampling Mode[/b]
Craving ultra-crisp visuals? Supersampling mode pushes fidelity beyond native resolution for razor-sharp scenes.[/p][p][b]New Opening Cut scene[/b] A new introductory cinematic has been added, setting a chilling tone and drawing players deeper into the world of [i]Soul Gather[/i]. [b] [/b][/p][p][b]New Main Menu Scene and boot scene[/b][/p][p]New Animated menu the UI is now in the middle and new boot scene  [/p][p][b]Resized Souls 1.0 to 0.5[/b][/p]

Plus, master the mechanics with a [b]tutorial level[/b], where you’ll learn to play and perfect your [b]wall-climbing[/b] skills.
